Coordinate semantics risk: after `window.scrollTo`, `page.mouse().move(x,y)` uses viewpor…
expected_issues.description: Coordinate semantics risk: after `window.scrollTo`, `page.mouse().move(x,y)` uses viewport coordinates, while your scroll calculation assumes `x/y` are document coordinates (and the debug marker uses `position:absolute` on `body`, also document coordinates). If callers provide viewport coords, scrolling will shift the target and you’ll click the wrong spot; if callers provide document coords, you should click at `(x - scrollX, y - scrollY)` after scrolling. Please clarify/normalize coordinates and keep marker/click consistent (also consider `position: fixed` for viewport marker).
